description: Twenty-six, and a shire he will not choose

participation.context: Named tomorrow at ten, and chose no shire.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted twenty-six shillings, and kept them.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Offered Kent or the west, and refused to marry them.
participation.name: William Sly

relations.quote: Twenty-six is my stair, not your purse.

story.body: You came off dead and stood in the door. You left Margery's twenty-six shillings as she had spoken them. You left Kent or the west unchosen. You took tomorrow at ten, once, as the hour the book has been waiting for since Monday.

relations.quote: Twenty-six is my stair, not your purse.

title: Heard Margery's twenty-six shillings and kept tomorrow at ten
